claims.assertion: Act 351/2022 covers specified products and consumer services and separately routes electronic communications, audiovisual access, and 112 accessibility to other legislation.
claims.review_note: Current law version 30 May 2026; version-specific statutory URL opened 24 September 2026. Do not extend the SOI remit to sectors expressly governed by separate acts.

claims.assertion: A dedicated public accessibility-statement page comparable to a WAD declaration is explicitly required of covered services.
claims.review_note: Existing ❓ Unknown preserved. SOI official follow-up received 19 February 2026 asking about a dedicated page, and reminder on 24 September 2026; no response in the supplied thread.

claims.assertion: Providers must make conformity information publicly available in general service conditions or comparable document, in accessible written and oral forms for the service duration.
claims.review_note: Isolated no-history Slovak-language review 24 September 2026: original 'vo všeobecných podmienkach na poskytovanie služby alebo v obdobnom dokumente', literal 'in general conditions for providing the service or similar document'; final wording supported with precision; no dedicated page implied. isolated no-history Slovak-to-English language agent, 2026-09-24: §6(2) original 'vo všeobecných podmienkach na poskytovanie služby alebo v obdobnom dokumente' and 'v písomnej forme a ústnej forme'; literal 'in general conditions for provision of service or a comparable document', 'in written and oral form'. Reviewed wording 'Service accessibility information appears in general terms or equivalent document, in accessible written and oral form'; verdict Supported with precision that terms concern the service and no dedicated page follows from this provision. Final wording in record uses 'general service conditions or comparable document'.

claims.assertion: The provider must give necessary conformity documents to the competent authority on reasoned request in the state language.
Provider conformity documents must be handed to any member of public on request.
claims.review_note: §8(3) concerns authority information on request; do not conflate provider and authority.

claims.assertion: SOI oversees covered consumer services (specified passenger-transport channels and terminals, financial services, e-books and specialized software, and information-society services) and specified products under product accessibility technical regulation.
claims.review_note: SOI official site reached 24 September 2026. Isolated language review corrected overbroad 'banking' and 'e-commerce' summaries to statutory categories. isolated no-history Slovak-to-English language agent, 2026-09-24: §2(1) original 'služby poskytované spotrebiteľom ... finančné služby ... elektronické knihy a špecializovaný softvér ... služby informačnej spoločnosti'; literal 'consumer services ... financial services ... e-books and specialized software ... information society services'. Reviewed initial wording 'banking, e-commerce, transport digital channels and terminals'; verdict Correction needed because categories and transport exclusions were compressed. Final publication wording 'specified products and consumer services under Act 351/2022' is narrowed; agency headings are navigational labels, not an exhaustive legal scope. §2(5) original 'ustanovujú osobitné predpisy'; literal 'separate regulations establish them'; final separate-agency headings reflect this without assigning 112 by inference.
claims.scope: Products; passenger transport; financial services; e-books; information society services

claims.assertion: Regulatory Authority for Electronic Communications and Postal Services supervises accessibility duties of publicly available electronic communications services.
claims.review_note: The teleoff.gov.sk contact page was indexed but reader returned an internal error on opening; authority legal remit verified independently. Agency link reachability unknown. The §83a(2)(d) nonconformity duty explicitly identifies the regulator. Post-draft ordinary-browser attempt on https://www.teleoff.gov.sk/kontakt/ (24 September 2026) returned 502 Bad Gateway and 'Certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate'; did not bypass certificate validation. Agency remit remains independently verified by the current statute; site destination and EAA intake remain unverified in this browser. Requested retry on 24 September 2026: direct ordinary browser again returned 502 Bad Gateway with certificate verification failure at https://www.teleoff.gov.sk/kontakt/; no bypass or intake observation.

claims.assertion: Council for Media Services supervises audiovisual multimodal access services under media-services law.
claims.review_note: Limit this to multimodal access under §60b; do not imply every type of audiovisual accessibility is within the same duty. Site and relevant report form reached 24 September 2026.

claims.assertion: Authority supervising 112 answering/handling accessibility can be identified from the checked sources.
claims.review_note: Exact competent body for the answering/handling aspect unresolved; do not infer from electronic communications provider duty.

claims.assertion: SOI accepts public reports for its covered product and service remit at podnety@soi.sk.
claims.review_note: Official public instructions direct inspection reports and enquiries to its form. Post-draft ordinary-browser pass 24 September 2026 reached https://www.soi.sk/nahlasit-podnet and displayed name, trader, product/service, incident-description and attachment fields, a declaration checkbox, CAPTCHA and submit button, with no error banner in this browser. Its EAA-specific purpose and actual submission were not observed; the form is a general inspection-report intake. No form filled or submitted. Email is general SOI reports, not labelled dedicated EAA. Website says info@soi.sk for information requests; public email distinct from company correspondence. isolated no-history Slovak-to-English language agent, 2026-09-24: §8(2)(b) original 'prešetruje podnety týkajúce sa nesúladu služby s požiadavkami na prístupnosť'; literal 'investigates submissions concerning a service's failure to meet accessibility requirements'. Reviewed 'SOI investigates public reports about noncompliant services'; verdict Correction needed because 'public' is unstated and noncompliance may be alleged. Final research wording: 'SOI investigates reports alleging that a service fails to meet accessibility requirements'; public route audience follows SOI's public reporting instructions, not §8 alone. Requested retry on 24 September 2026: direct ordinary browser again opened the page and displayed a general report form (product/service selector, trader details, description, CAPTCHA, submit button) without an in-browser error; the automated text extraction still displayed an error notice. No fields were submitted, so operational submission and EAA-specific purpose remain unverified.

claims.assertion: The §6(1)(d) duty requires providers of Act 351 services to report actual nonconformity and corrective measures promptly to domestic and relevant host-state authorities.
claims.review_note: SOI's direct email confirms reports generally; whether this specific statutory notice and exemptions use that same inbox was not expressly answered; table uses broad 'Company reports', not purpose-specific statutory label. isolated no-history Slovak-to-English language agent, 2026-09-24: original §6(1)(d) 'bezodkladne informovať príslušný orgán dohľadu ... o dôvodoch ... nie je v súlade ... a o nápravných opatreniach'; literal 'promptly inform the competent authority of reasons why the service is not compliant and corrective measures'. Reviewed 'when they cannot meet accessibility requirements'; verdict Correction needed because actual nonconformity and host-state authority were omitted. Final claim states actual nonconformity and corrective measures to domestic and relevant host-state authorities.

claims.assertion: The §7(5) written notification for fundamental alteration or disproportionate burden is a mandatory, purpose-specific EAA Article 14 analogue.
claims.review_note: Do not infer that the general SOI reporting email is the purpose-specific exemption channel; §7(2) assessment retained five years and provided to authority on request. Service microenterprises exempt under §2(3).
